comment: Wizard-mode Priestess genocides the D, H, c, Y and X classes with blessed scrolls, which removes 14 of wizard.c's 44 nasties, writes Elbereth and creates an arch-lich. The remaining keys dismiss --More--, refuse wizard-mode deaths and force searches until the arch-lich's summon nasties spell picks a genocided species: makemon() refuses it, and nasty() asks makemon(NULL, x, y, MM_NOMSG) for a substitute, whose species starts a group through m_initgrp() with MM_NOMSG | MM_NOGRP. The keys were chosen by a script that answered the screen, not copied from any recorded game.
